functions.description: Parse syslog header: timestamp, host, process, pid, severity, event_type, and remaining key=value payload
Extract key=value pairs (component, status, user, src_ip, dst_ip, reason, etc.) from the KVP payload
Normalize severity to standard log levels

add.name: severity
add.value: severity === 'CRIT' ? 'critical' : severity === 'ERR' ? 'error' : severity === 'WARN' ? 'warning' : severity === 'NOTICE' ? 'notice' : severity === 'INFO' ? 'info' : severity

functions.description: Derive normalized action field from status for auth/session/service events

add.name: action
add.value: status === 'SUCCESS' ? 'allowed' : status === 'FAILED' ? 'blocked' : status === 'DOWN' ? 'down' : status === 'UP' ? 'up' : status === 'DEGRADED' ? 'degraded' : status === 'NEAR_LIMIT' ? 'warning' : status === 'RESTART_FAILED' ? 'failed' : status

functions.description: Cleanup scratch fields no longer needed after extraction
